info.title: CDRMAPP API
info.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamps. Tokens expire after one day. Web uses same-origin secure session+CSRF rather than exposing tokens in browser storage. All incident collections are scoped; analytics never return raw personal data. Live integrations and remaining gaps are in IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md.
